expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖租户、权限、上传和支付异常
expectations.evidence: Architecture and delivery documents substantively cover tenant isolation, approval authorization, failed/malicious uploads, payment timeout, duplicate and out-of-order callbacks.

expectations.text: 安全文档覆盖敏感数据、多租户、SSO 和支付
expectations.evidence: 02-security-privacy includes identity, invoice and bank data, tenant isolation, SSO, payment, uploads and audit controls.

expectations.text: 合规事项标记官方核源与负责人而非认证结论
expectations.evidence: Open items are tagged [LEGAL]/[SECURITY]/[BUSINESS], and the review definition explicitly denies legal review or compliance certification.

expectations.text: 区域数据边界与 RPO/RTO 有验证方案
expectations.evidence: Documents specify CN/EU/US data planes, EU-only recovery, and measured regional restore evidence for ≤15m RPO and ≤2h RTO.

expectations.text: 未决高风险事项阻断生产就绪度
expectations.evidence: The documents list blocking review items and exit conditions, but do not maintain a production-ready status or explicitly mark that gate blocked.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong baseline content; the skill mainly adds explicit stage-gate semantics and traceability.
